parameters.query:
SELECT * 
FROM mydatabase.token_agenda_ford
WHERE company = 2
ORDER BY id DESC
LIMIT 1;

parameters.jsCode: return $('Conversaciones del bot').all().map(i => i.json).filter(f => f.selected_date && f.plate).map(f => { const d = String(f.selected_date).slice(0, 10); return { json: { dealer: String(f.sucursal || '60834'), page: 1, body: { dealer: String(f.sucursal || '60834'), country: 'ARG', startDate: d, endDate: d, types: ['NORMAL'], search: String(f.plate).toUpperCase() } } }; });

parameters.query:
SELECT id_conversation, plate, chassi, model, sucursal, company, selected_date, selected_hour, service_id, created_at, updated_at
FROM agenda_ford
WHERE ((created_at >= '2026-10-01 03:00:00' AND created_at < '2026-10-11 03:00:00')
    OR (created_at >= '2026-11-01 03:00:00' AND created_at < '2026-11-11 03:00:00'))
ORDER BY created_at;
